Use of IWILFIN for this indication is supported by evidence from adequate and well-controlled studies in pediatric patients with a median age of 4 years (range: 1 to 17) [see Adverse Reactions (6.1) , Clinical Pharmacology (12.3) , Clinical Studies (14.1)].
